handoff: Approve: all 7 criteria (Where you run placement, attended, unattended+runner+permission, auto/manual, no-runner fallback, --json facts, every combination) traced to brief.test.ts; tests and typecheck green; 1 minor note on the auto line wording.

findings.title: "Mode auto: your report starts the next step at once" is not literal in every case
findings.detail:
The line renders whenever mode_requested is auto and a runner exists, including on an attended step (whose own effective mode is manual) and when the next step is attended or max_agents is full, where nothing starts at once. AC7 asks that no line promise what norn doesn't do. The wording matches the spec's D2 and user story 11, and the implementer noted it in the handoff, so it is left as a note for the person.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: If the person wants it exact: "your report lets norn start the next unattended step on its own".
